ai.title: BMP and TIFF images are now refused or transcoded to PNG
ai.summary: The CLI image handler and the SDK read_files tool now both consult the new isProviderSupportedImageMediaType helper from common/src/constants/images to decide whether an image's media type can reach a vision provider.
